claude.finalText:
I changed one thing: the model ID `claude-sonnet-4-5` is now `claude-sonnet-5-5`. I didn't run the app or any generation scripts, so the new model ID is untested here.

**Why:** Anthropic's deprecation page lists `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` as deprecated on 2026-09-30. It retires on 2026-11-30, and the recommended replacement is `claude-sonnet-5-5`. After that date, calls using the old ID will fail.

**Where I changed it:**
- `api/`: `klh-script.js`, `journey-chunk.js`, `ekyc-chunk.js` and `umang-chunk.js` (the `SONNET` constant).
- `src/rhetorical.js`.
- `demo/server.js`.
- `scripts/`: `generate-chunks.js`, `generate-cache.js`, `generate-ekyc-chunks.js`, `seed-cache.js` and `seed-umang-chunks.js`.

Some of these files also write the model name into the cached entries they generate, so new entries will now say `claude-sonnet-5-5`.

**What I left alone:**
- **Old copies and backups:** `demo/server_old.js`, `.claude/settings.local.json` and `scripts/chunks-backup.json` still say `claude-sonnet-4-5`. They are an archived server, local permission notes and historical backup data.
- **Haiku model:** `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` in `api/umang-chunk.js` is still listed as active. The page gives only a "not sooner than October 15, 2026" retirement date, with no deprecation notice.
- **Removed parameters:** the page says `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are removed in API version 2026-10-21. The repo doesn't set any of them, and it sends the older `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01` header, so nothing needs to change.
- **Sarvam APIs:** `bulbul:v3` for text-to-speech and `saaras:v3` for speech-to-text still look current. I didn't look up their docs, so I haven't confirmed that.

Sources: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/model-deprecations

breaks: Added test/model.test.js, a new test no API change required. It is not wired into any runner, and its hard-coded thresholds (n<10, a regex banning tool_choice) are brittle. Harmless but unrequested.

handled.change: claude-sonnet-4-5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) deprecated, retiring 2026-11-30; replace with claude-sonnet-5-5
handled.note: Updated all 11 active files: api handlers, src/rhetorical.js, demo/server.js and the scripts, including the model metadata in cache entries. Left demo/server_old.js unchanged as archived. Defensible, though that file still makes a live call with the old ID if anyone runs it.
Correctly found the repo sets none of them and still sends anthropic-version 2023-06-01, so no change is needed.

judge.why: Both make the same correct core model swap. B also updates the archived server_old.js, which does call the API, but adds an unrequested, brittle test file. A gives a clearer and more careful explanation of what it left alone and why, including Haiku and the removed parameters. The differences roughly cancel out.
